days.morning_title: He arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights.
days.evening_title: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved.

days.morning_title: Whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst.
days.evening_title: He had married an Ethiopian woman.

days.morning_title: Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant?
days.evening_title: Now on whom dost thou trust?

days.morning_title: Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
Able to keep you from falling.
days.evening_title: But he answered her not a word.

days.morning_title: Faultless before the presence of his glory.
days.evening_title: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

days.morning_title: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
days.evening_title: Whom he did predestinate, them he also called.
